name: gh
question: One GitHub operation through the gh CLI (the extra arguments): an issue comment on #218, a read of runs or comments, or a workflow_dispatch of ci.yml on main. Permitted GitHub traffic only.
choices: In a job without the container; the operation (the gh subcommand and its arguments) and the endpoint are journaled. Only these subcommands are used: issue comment 218 --repo klucilla/refute --body-file <committed or .cache file>; run list / run view --repo klucilla/refute; api GET repos/klucilla/refute/...; workflow run ci.yml --repo klucilla/refute --ref main. A data unit: the arguments make the unit.
